verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Metronome stores raw revenue-recognition data with daily granularity and can export data to a warehouse for building reports/dashboards (docs-9, docs-33, docs-10), but there is no evidence of native, computed MRR, churn, cohort retention, or LTV analytics inside Metronome itself — the documented path is explicitly to export raw data to an external BI/warehouse tool, which is the opposite of what the story asks for.
